kicker: vLLM, read from the v1 engine

scenes.headline: How vLLM turned paged memory into a prefix cache
scenes.sub: The v1 engine: a block pool, a hash chain, one token budget.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Bobble! vLLM is sold as PagedAttention plus continuous batching. Here's what that grew into.

scenes.text: Once the KV cache is cut into fixed 16-token blocks behind a table, each block can be named by a hash of the whole prefix ending there.
scenes.mark: a hash of the whole prefix
scenes.say: Cut the KV cache into fixed blocks behind a table, and each block can be named by its content. Memory becomes a cache.

scenes.title: Share of KV cache holding live tokens
scenes.say: Why blocks? A contiguous reservation per request wastes most of it: even knowing the true length, thirty-eight percent. Blocks reach ninety-six.

steps.say: A request's logical blocks map through a table to physical blocks anywhere in the pool, sixteen tokens each.
Each full block is hashed into a flat map, so a request with the same prefix reuses it.
When a request ends, its blocks join the free queue but keep their hashes. Free is not evicted.
A block is evicted only when something else takes the memory. Until then, it still hits.

parts.note: the previous block's hash, so the whole prefix
parts.say: It folds in the parent's hash, since the same tokens after a different prompt have different keys and values.

parts.note: LoRA ids, image hashes, a per-tenant salt
parts.say: Extra keys add LoRA ids and a salt, so two tenants can't read each other's cache.

scenes.title: One token budget per step
scenes.say: The scheduler has no prefill or decode phase, just a budget.

items.say: Running requests take what they need first, one token for a plain decode.
Waiting prompts spend what's left. Run out mid-prompt, and that's chunked prefill.
Out of blocks, a request is preempted and recomputed later. The swap path is gone.

scenes.text: Fixed blocks made KV memory addressable, chained hashes made it a cache, and one token budget schedules all of it.
scenes.mark: chained hashes made it a cache
scenes.say: Blocks made memory addressable, chained hashes made it a cache, and one budget schedules it.

recap: Each hash names the whole prefix
One budget: chunked prefill falls out
scenes.say: To recap: fixed blocks, chained hashes, and one budget for everything.
